question: Does weighting improve fixed-target empirical fidelity?
methods_and_scope: 54 corrected Adult development cells; 12 frozen confirmation cells; same locally tuned models and five 10k draws
metric: alpha-standardized Q_primary_v2 query max; constrained minus size
result: 0/18 Adult development and 0/6 confirmation partition/K slices reached -0.005; overall confirmation delta -0.000215
limitations: Other populations, workloads and privacy-matched aggregation

question: How close are candidates to a finite-pilot oracle?
methods_and_scope: 57 certified fixed-pilot LPs; six-cell four-size/five-seed pilot sensitivity
metric: LP certificate, pilot regret and fresh-sample query loss
result: Finite matrix optimum certified; larger pilots reduced numerical excess but did not establish practical fresh-sample gain
limitations: Population optimum or globally optimal nonlinear operators

question: Do overlapping client subsets add mixture expressivity?
methods_and_scope: Cyclic subset effective-weight identity and saved numerical check
metric: Equality of effective client mass and resulting mixture
result: Mixtures of subset mixtures collapse to one global mixture

question: What changes with synthetic sample size?
methods_and_scope: Six checkpoints, m=2500/10000/40000, five draws each
metric: query error, draw variation, diversity, runtime
result: Draw variation shrank; model error persisted; no practical constrained gain
limitations: Other families or very large m

question: When does conditional synthesis succeed or abstain?
methods_and_scope: Six development student/direct-teacher cells; frozen 12-cell four-condition confirmation
metric: support, acceptance, violations, within-condition query max
result: Direct teacher default; older-doctorate request abstained 12/12. Female-condition relationship=Husband was the worst query in all 12 confirmation cells: zero alpha-standardized real frequency, generated 0.340?0.399, mean absolute error 0.375 despite zero condition violations.
limitations: Arbitrary-condition fidelity certification or learned cross-condition generalization

question: Does synthetic training preserve income probability utility?
methods_and_scope: Paired logistic/extra-trees, synthetic TSTR and privileged real TRTR, six development and 12 confirmation cells
metric: Brier, AUROC, AUPRC, log loss, subgroup coverage
result: At registered unequal budgets, size logistic Brier 0.129818 versus privileged TRTR 0.101987 and AUROC 0.856167 versus 0.904646. TRTR used 21,148/4,880/3,254 real train/tune/calibration rows versus 10,000/2,000/2,000 generated rows; no matched-size effect inferred.
limitations: Independent cohort utility and small unsupported subgroups

question: Can a joint model imply an income predictor?
methods_and_scope: Six same-person projected development comparisons; exact finite Chow-Liu route and approximate GMM route
metric: paired Brier/AUROC, two-label mass, abstention coverage
result: Observed-row coverage 100%; exact-score preimages audited; approximate routes labelled
limitations: Universal off-support coverage and exact copula/GMM probabilities

question: Which queries fail?
methods_and_scope: 10,500 development query answers, 175 queries; frozen official primary/audit answers
metric: max/mean error, arity, support, named worst query
result: Official size primary mean 0.022216; dominant HS-grad/high-income query in 33/60 size draws
limitations: Arbitrary-query guarantee; independent inference from viewed audit

question: Which registered components explain results?
methods_and_scope: 12 same-row projection, six fixed-checkpoint summary-access ablations, historical capacity comparison
metric: paired primary/query errors and access bytes
result: Structural repair and access changes matter; no isolated component establishes a practical general weighting gain

question: How does controlled heterogeneity affect correction?
methods_and_scope: Six G* fixed-quantity K5 cells at severity 0.25/0.85 and seeds711/722/733
metric: achieved skew, local error, oracle headroom, fidelity
result: Registered contrasts terminal; fixed 1000 train/200 tune per client and equal-alpha mechanism target
limitations: Full causal isolation of assignment and conditional relationships

question: What finite-query conditional transfer follows?
methods_and_scope: Elementary proposition, binary counterexample, 48 bound rows and 5112 student/direct triangles
metric: ratio bound, support denominator, empirical triangle
result: Algebra checked; rare support makes bounds weak and triggers abstention

question: What privacy, access and resource claims survive?
methods_and_scope: Complete release ledger, atom-aware histogram epsilon1/4/8, four adapted FLAIM fits, three matched payload cells
metric: adjacency/composition, serialized bytes, runtime, attack diagnostics
result: Main pipeline nonprivate; model+metadata 1.915-2.866x matched raw bytes; conditional histogram epsilon13 if three settings released
limitations: Whole-pipeline DP, WAN/security measurement and privacy-matched FLAIM ranking
